Student loan borrowers sue over debt forgiveness credit report issues

Student loan borrowers have filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration concerning issues with their credit reports following debt forgiveness. The lawsuit addresses how forgiven debts are being reflected on credit histories. Separately, it is reported that over 10 million student loan borrowers are currently behind on their payments, facing potential wage garnishment and the seizure of Social Security benefits.
